text:
mira: spotted a KMS-wrapped ciphertext in a partner debug bundle we pulled. id: PTBL_55c. not posting blob. key hint: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-ring/cryptoKeys/ingest-main. can we triage?
alex: on it. first step I'll list IAM on that key and grep other ciphertexts in the bundle.
chloe: immediate mitigation: lock down cryptoKeyDecrypter to only nexus-ingest-sa and a short-lived rewrap-sa. prepare RBAC PR, tag @security-review.
ops-oncall: can do a midnight UTC window for a canary rewrap (00:30). will create runbook and temp Vault transit key if needed.
security-bot: :warning: Incident INC-3172 created (potential secret exposure). assigned eng-security.
mira: pinged partner ops with minimal wording; legal cc'd. asked them to rotate any credentials they control.
alex: preflight finds 2 other ciphertext ids tied to the same key. will post counts to runbook, then run a dry-run rewrap.
chloe: RBAC PR draft ready; restricting decrypt to serviceAccount:partners-ingest-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com and rewrap-sa with 24h lifetime. adding conditional binding by VPC if supported.
ops-oncall: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INC-3172-rotor. schedule confirmed. will enable KMS admin audit export to bq for 90d before rotation.
security-bot: :lock: checklist: [x] incident INC-3172, [ ] IAM PR, [ ] audit export, [ ] rewrap canary, [ ] full rotate, [ ] partner confirm.
mira: keeping updates short here; runbook is canonical. thanks all.
